_comment: Example ~/.claude/settings.json built from a real setup with paths generalised and secrets removed. Keys starting with _comment are notes; delete them. Merge by hand into your own settings; do not overwrite.
_comment_includeCoAuthoredBy: Set to taste. false keeps the Claude co-author line out of commits.

permissions._comment_allow: On macOS or Linux use Bash(...) patterns instead of PowerShell(...). Keep allow rules narrow; avoid blanket rules for tools that can delete or publish.

statusLine._comment: Needs the token-optimizer plugin. Check the script path after install; it can change between versions.

_comment_hooks: The real setup defines no hooks of its own; all hooks come from the ecc plugin. The block below is an ILLUSTRATIVE example only: a Stop hook that appends a timestamp to a log. Remove it or replace it with your own.
_comment_autoMode: Auto mode accepts an environment description (autoMode.environment) telling the classifier which folders and machines are yours. Write your own in plain words; never list secret file contents there.

environment: Single-user workstation. The user owns everything under ~ and approves their own prompts.
Project folders live under ~/Workspace. Secrets live in files outside the repos and are never printed.
